final_message:
Fixed. Slots whose names start with an underscore (`<template #_slot2>`) render their content again instead of the child's default content.

**Status:** reproduced before the fix, fixed, and verified.

**Reproduction.** I couldn't decode the playground link (the decode step was blocked), so I rebuilt the case from the conditions in the report. A `SubComponent` with slots `_slot1`, `_slot2` and `slot3` sits inside the default slot of `BaseLayout`. The same `BaseLayout` also receives a conditionally rendered `<template v-if="show" #footer>`. Before the fix, `_slot1` and `_slot2` rendered their fallback text (`default1|default2|three`) while `slot3` rendered its template. The same layout passes with non-underscore names, and with underscore names when there is no `v-if` sibling.

Command (fails before the fix, passes after):

    pnpm vitest run --project unit packages/vue/__tests__/index.spec.ts packages/runtime-core/__tests__/componentSlots.spec.ts

**Cause.** In 3.5.14, `assignSlots` changed from `key !== '_'` to `!isInternalKey(key)`. `isInternalKey` matches every key starting with `_`. A `v-if` template slot on the parent makes its `<slot>` outlets render with `BAIL`, so child components inside that slot content are patched non-optimized. Their slots then go through `assignSlots`, which silently dropped every `_`-prefixed slot. HMR updates take the same route.

**Fix** (`packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts`). I added `isReservedKey`, which matches only the real markers `_`, `__`, `_ctx` and `$stable`. `assignSlots` and the stale-slot removal in `updateSlots` now use it.

Removal had the same flaw. Before the fix, toggling a `v-if`'d `_`-named slot off left the old content in place, even in optimized mode.

Hand-written slot objects such as `h(Comp, null, { _inner: ... })` still ignore `_`-prefixed keys. An existing test asserts that on purpose, and the report is about compiled templates, so I left it alone.

**Tests added** (all fail on the original source and pass with the fix):
- `packages/vue/__tests__/index.spec.ts`: the report's layout end to end, including toggling the `footer` slot on and off.
- `packages/runtime-core/__tests__/componentSlots.spec.ts`:
  - underscore-named slots are kept when compiled slots are rendered by a manual render function;
  - markers `_`, `__` and `$stable` are not copied;
  - underscore-named dynamic slots update correctly in non-optimized mode;
  - stale underscore-named slots are removed in optimized mode.

**Verification.** The full unit suite passes (3377 tests), except one timing-based perf test in `reactivity/computed`. It failed under parallel load and passes when run alone. Type-check, eslint and prettier are clean on the changed files.
